sections.text:
[Effects]
Physical and magic damage taken reduces by S+ - XL based on the water elemental defense value.
Nullifies Paralysis.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Paralysis is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Fire enemies increases to L.
